ns2:section.sectionText: Black Identities in Blockbuster Cinema. This course is a dynamic exploration of images and representations of Black peope and their identities in film. It is a highly interactive and engaging conceptual overview of controversial scholarly and popular literature, national discussions, and popular cultural images pertaiing to race, class, gender, identity, and cinematic messaging. The class will view and critique several films. Additionally, guest lectures and classroom activities will facilitate dialogue about the social construction of race in the United States and how Hollywood globally exports fragments of this discursive formation. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restriced to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
